description: Draws four Tarot de Marseille cards (Major Arcana) for one question and returns AskY's written reading of them: the cards, what each one says, how they read together, a piece of advice and a question to take away. Use when someone asks for a tarot reading about a question of their own. Pass only the question itself, not the conversation. Questions about a medical diagnosis, death, gambling, harming someone, or from someone in crisis are not read: the tool returns a supportive message or a gentler question instead of cards. The question is used only to write the reading and is then erased; the number of readings depends on what the person's account includes; when it is reached the tool says so. Requires the person to be signed in to their AskY account; the reading is saved to that account.

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" for English or "es" for Spanish. Use the language the person is writing in. Defaults to "en".

name.description: Optional first name to address the person by, only if they gave it in the conversation. Never invent one. Letters only, up to 40 characters.

question.description: The person's own question, in their words, without the rest of the conversation. One question, 3 to 1500 characters. Example: "Will this new job make me happier?"
examples: Will this new job make me happier?
What do I need to understand about this relationship?
¿Qué necesito para dar el siguiente paso en mi trabajo?

topic.description: Optional area of the question: love, work, health (health and wellbeing), friendship, or life (personal growth). Leave it out if unclear; the reading still works.

name: get_tarot_reading

asky.description: Data for showing the result as cards. Left out when there are no cards (for example a message instead of a reading).

name.description: French Tarot de Marseille name, e.g. "L'Hermite".

position.description: Place in the spread (readings only), else null.

reversed.description: True if the card came up reversed.

sub.description: Name in the answer's language, e.g. "The Hermit".

line.description: One-line thought or summary; null when there is none.

url.description: Page on askyreadings.com, with utm tags.

title.description: Heading, e.g. "Today's card" / "La carta de hoy".

view.description: What kind of result this is: one card, or the cards of a reading.

text.description: The full answer in Markdown, ready to show.

title: Tarot reading
